question: Where does my money go in a usual month?
title: A usual month

cells.title: The three baskets of a usual month
cells.code:
partial = bool(kori.safe_to_save().get("partial_view"))          # pay moves to another bank: only part of the month is visible here

um = kori.usual_month()
LBL = {"Housing": "Housing", "Restaurants": "Eating out", "Groceries": "Groceries", "Home & Tech": "Home & tech", "Transportation": "Getting around", "Entertainment": "Fun", "Lifestyle": "Shopping", "Utilities": "Utilities", "Health": "Health", "Travel": "Trips"}
BAS = {"fixed": "Fixed musts", "surprise": "Surprise musts", "everyday": "Everyday"}
d = tx[tx["is_spend"] & tx["month"].isin(last12)]
basket_of = d.groupby("category")["basket"].agg(lambda s: s.mode().iat[0]).to_dict()
cats = sorted(((c, v) for c, v in um["categories"].items() if v > 0.005 and basket_of.get(c) == "everyday"), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:5]
parts = {"fixed": um["fixed"], "surprise": um["surprise"], "everyday": um["everyday"]}
top = max(parts, key=parts.get)
left = um["left_over"]
emit("income", round(um["income"], 2), "eur_per_month", "Comes in, a usual month")
emit("fixed", round(um["fixed"], 2), "eur_per_month", BAS["fixed"])
emit("surprise", round(um["surprise"], 2), "eur_per_month", BAS["surprise"])
emit("everyday", round(um["everyday"], 2), "eur_per_month", BAS["everyday"])
emit("spend", round(um["spend"], 2), "eur_per_month", "Goes out, a usual month")
emit("invested", round(um.get("invested") or 0.0, 2), "eur_per_month", "Moved to savings, a usual month")
emit("left_abs", round(abs(left), 2), "eur_per_month", "A usual month leaves" if left >= 0 else "A usual month is short by")
emit("left_label", "A usual month leaves" if left >= 0 else "A usual month is short by", "text", "What the last line says")
emit("top_basket", BAS[top], "text", "The biggest of the three baskets")
table("everyday_top", [{"label": LBL.get(c, c), "usual": round(v, 2)} for c, v in cats] or [{"label": BAS["everyday"], "usual": round(um["everyday"], 2)}], "Biggest everyday costs, a usual month")

if not partial and um["income"] > 0 and um["spend"] > 0:
    say(f"In a usual month **{eur(um['spend'])}** goes out: {eur(um['fixed'])} fixed musts, {eur(um['surprise'])} surprise musts and {eur(um['everyday'])} everyday." + (f" Of the {eur(um['income'])} that comes in, that leaves {eur(left)}." if left >= 0 else f" That is {eur(-left)} more than a usual month leaves room for."))
